title: Game Fusion
tagline: Play classic games in your browser, then remix their mechanics into something new.
stateNote: Runs in the browser. You bring your own ROMs; two original games are included.
problem: Classic games are full of great mechanics, but you can't easily pull them apart and combine them. Game Fusion is a library, an emulator and a lab for that.
audience: Players and tinkerers who like classic games.
contribution: It is my project, built with Vite and TypeScript. The source is private.
worksToday: Import your own ROMs and play them with saves, per the README.
Two original games, Glimmerfen and Kong Quest, are playable.
A Fusion Lab and a Reverse Lab for studying and combining mechanics.
limitations: No commercial games are included; you supply your own ROMs.
The creation agent needs an API key on the server.
